answer: Each agent action per epoch must carry a blind-signed token from its paid inference provider, which mints only three per billing account. A verifier like the Raven market checks tokens without learning the account, so privacy holds, yet an operator with one subscription gets the same three tokens for 5 or 500 clones; the trellis of fakes starves. A sybil gale needs hundreds of separately paid, verified accounts, so cost grows with every fake.
